capabilities.title: Playwright (browser automation)
capabilities.description: Microsoft's official browser-automation MCP server. Drives Chromium/Firefox/WebKit through the accessibility tree, so models act on structured page state instead of screenshots. This is the default computer-use / chrome-use capability.

capabilities.title: Browser Use
capabilities.description: Agentic browser automation that navigates the web like a human: it handles forms, clicks, and CAPTCHA flows through a real browser. Exposed as MCP under com.browser-use/browser-use. Requires a model provider key because it is itself an agent.

capabilities.title: Invisible Playwright (anti-bot)
capabilities.description: Playwright MCP server on anti-detect stealth Firefox, tuned to be invisible to anti-bots and CAPTCHAs. Use for scraping and computer-use on sites that block vanilla browsers.

capabilities.title: SearXNG (self-hosted metasearch)
capabilities.description: Self-hosted metasearch that aggregates multiple engines (Google, Bing, Brave, DuckDuckGo and more) behind one privacy-respecting API. Recommended as the primary search capability to avoid per-engine ads and rate limits.

capabilities.title: Brave Search API
capabilities.description: Brave's independent search index over a clean JSON API. A compliant alternative to scraping Google results. Requires a Brave Search API key.

capabilities.title: Tavily Search API
capabilities.description: Search and extract API purpose-built for agents, with a ready MCP server. Requires a Tavily API key.

capabilities.title: Google Custom Search (official API)
capabilities.description: The compliant way to query Google: Google's official Custom Search JSON API, not result-page scraping. Requires GOOGLE_API_KEY and a GOOGLE_CSE_ID; subject to Google's quota and terms.

capabilities.title: Filesystem (official)
capabilities.description: Official MCP reference server exposing a configurable directory root for read/write file operations. Mirrors the employee filesystem scope.

capabilities.title: Memory (official)
capabilities.description: Official MCP reference server for a knowledge-graph-based persistent memory store.

capabilities.title: Git (official)
capabilities.description: Official MCP reference server for git operations: status, diff, log, and commit against a local repository.

capabilities.title: Fetch (official)
capabilities.description: Official MCP reference server that fetches a URL and returns its content as Markdown, bound to host policy for egress.

capabilities.title: Playwright CLI (SKILLS)
capabilities.description: Token-efficient browser automation as a CLI exposed through skills, preferred for high-throughput coding agents that want concise commands instead of verbose MCP tool schemas.
